response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, but his expertise is heavily skewed toward web, mobile, and scripting languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, D, etc.) rather than C++. His C++ experience is limited to early roles (e.g., National Instruments) and lacks the depth required for mid-senior C++ roles in industrial automation or high-performance systems. Additionally, his resume does not demonstrate exposure to STL, multi-threading, message brokers, or industrial cybersecurity standards like IEC 62443.
strengths: Strong full-stack development skills across multiple languages (Node.js, TypeScript, React)
Experience with performance optimization in low-latency systems (e.g., DLang, microservices)
Proven ability to mentor teams and contribute to open-source projects
concerns: Limited C++ experience (only early roles, no recent or deep C++ development)
No demonstrated exposure to STL, multi-threading, or message brokers required for the role
Lacks experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or on-prem/cloud platform solutions for automation machinery
